info.title: Granite Manager API
info.description: JSON API behind Granite Manager, a CRM for countertop and stone fabrication companies. Every request acts as the signed-in user and only sees data of that user's company.

get.description:
Returns the user behind the session, including their permission flags and
the company every other request acts in.

Returns the position ids (job roles such as sales rep) the user holds in
the company the request acts in.

200.description: Position ids in the current company

get.description:
Returns every non-deleted customer of the caller's company, optionally
filtered by sales rep. Invalid leads are hidden unless `show_invalid=1`.
With `view=companies` it returns only customers that have a company name,
each with revenue and project totals. Rows carry the primary email only;
use `POST /v1/customers/emails/batch` for all addresses.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description:
`customers` (default) lists every customer. `companies` lists only
customers with a company name and adds revenue and project totals.
Any other value is treated as `customers`.

parameters.name: sales_rep
parameters.description:
Only customers assigned to this sales rep (a user id, see
`GET /v1/users/sales-reps`). Omit or leave empty for all reps.

parameters.name: show_invalid
parameters.description:
`1` also returns leads marked invalid. Ignored when `view=companies`,
which never filters invalid leads out.

200.description: Customer rows, or company rows when `view=companies`

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

post.summary: Get all emails of several customers
post.description:
Returns every email address of the given customers, primary address
first, keyed by customer id. Customers without emails, and ids belonging
to another company, are absent from the result.

200.description: Map of customer id to email addresses, primary first

400.description: More than 20000 ids, or a malformed body

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

get.description:
Returns up to 15 live customers matching `term` by name (typos
tolerated, also matches the company name), phone digits, any email, or
company name. Customers with a live deal of the caller come first, then
the caller's own customers, then the best text matches. Each row carries
every email and the customer's latest deal. Fetch one in full with
`GET /v1/customers/{id}`.

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: What the user typed. Required (may be empty for phone search).

parameters.name: by
parameters.description: Which field to match: `name` (default), `phone`, `email`, `company`.

parameters.name: own_only
parameters.description: `true` returns only customers assigned to the caller or unassigned.

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

get.description:
Returns a live customer of the caller's company with contact details,
every email address (primary first) and the assigned sales rep. 404 for
deleted customers and other companies' customers.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Customer id

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

404.description: No such customer in the caller's company

get.description:
Returns the non-deleted users of the caller's company who hold the sales
rep position. Use their ids for the `sales_rep` filter of `GET /v1/customers`.

200.description: Sales reps of the current company

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

get.summary: List the company's stones with slab availability
get.description:
Returns the stones of the caller's company that are on display, sorted by
name, each with counts of its slabs in the yard (`slabs`). Sold out stones
(no available slab and not regular stock) are hidden unless
`include_sold_out=true`; hidden and deleted stones are never returned.
Filters combine with AND; list filters take the parameter repeated and
match any value. Color ids come from the colors list, supplier ids from
the suppliers list.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only stones of these types, e.g. `granite`, `quartz`, `marble`.

parameters.name: supplier_id
parameters.description: Only stones bought from this supplier (a supplier id).

parameters.name: color_id
parameters.description: Only stones tagged with at least one of these colors (color ids).

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Only stones of these price levels (1 = cheapest ... 7).

parameters.name: finishing
parameters.description: Only stones with these surface finishes: `polished`, `leathered`, `honed`.

parameters.name: include_sold_out
parameters.description:
`true` also returns sold out stones: no available slab and not regular
stock. Default `false`.

400.description: A filter has the wrong type, e.g. `supplier_id=abc`

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

get.summary: Search the company's stones by name
get.description:
Returns up to `limit` stones whose name contains `name`, best matches
first (name starts with it, then contains it as a word), each with the
same fields and slab counts as `GET /v1/stones`. By default only
displayed stones that are regular stock or have an available whole slab;
see `include_sold_out` and `include_hidden`.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Part of the stone name, case-insensitive. Empty returns no stones.

parameters.name: include_sold_out
parameters.description:
`true` also returns sold out stones. By default a stone is listed
when it is regular stock or has an available whole slab.

parameters.name: include_hidden
parameters.description:
`true` also returns stones hidden from the catalog (`is_display`
false). Default `false`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Most stones to return, 1 to 50. Default 25.

400.description: A parameter has the wrong type

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

post.summary: Add a stone with its slabs in one step
post.description:
Creates a displayed stone and either one leftover slab (bundle
`LO-YYYYMMDD-XXXX`) or one slab per bundle label, all with the given
size. Used while selling a slab that is not in the system yet. Returns
the stone and the new slab ids, ready to put on a sale.

400.description: Missing name, non-positive price, negative size, unknown stone type, or no bundles

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

get.description:
Returns every field of a stone of the caller's company, including hidden
(not displayed) stones, plus the ids of its colors. Deleted stones and
stones of other companies are 404. List its slabs with
`GET /v1/stones/{id}/slabs`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Stone id

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

404.description: No such stone in the caller's company

get.description:
Returns the slabs and remnants in the yard for a stone: its own plus
those of the stones it draws from (linked stones, marked with
`source_stone`). Cut and deleted slabs are left out. Sold slabs carry
their sale (customer, seller, date, notes, room, sinks); remnants carry
the sale of the slab they were cut from. Ordered by slab id; group by
`bundle` for display. Sell an available slab with the sales routes,
resize one with `PATCH /v1/slabs/{id}`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Stone id

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

404.description: No such stone in the caller's company

get.summary: List the company's sink models with free units
get.description:
Returns the non-deleted sink models of the caller's company, sorted by
name, each with the number of units free to sell (`available`). Models
not on display are included (`is_display`). Sold out models (no free unit
and not regular stock) are hidden unless `include_sold_out=true`. Filters
combine with AND; `type` takes the parameter repeated and matches any value.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
Only sink models of these types: `stainless 18 gauge`, `stainless 16 gauge`,
`composite`, `ceramic`, `farm house`. Repeat the parameter for several.

parameters.name: supplier_id
parameters.description: Only sink models bought from this supplier (a supplier id).

parameters.name: include_sold_out
parameters.description:
`true` also returns sold out models: no free unit and not regular
stock. Default `false`.

parameters.name: available_only
parameters.description:
`true` returns only models with at least one free unit, even regular
stock ones without units (what can be installed on a sale right now).
Overrides `include_sold_out`. Default `false`.

400.description: A filter has the wrong type, e.g. `supplier_id=abc`

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

get.summary: List the company's faucet models with free units
get.description:
Returns the non-deleted faucet models of the caller's company, sorted by
name, each with the number of units free to sell (`available`). Models
not on display are included (`is_display`). Sold out models (no free unit
and not regular stock) are hidden unless `include_sold_out=true`. Filters
combine with AND; `type` takes the parameter repeated and matches any value.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
Only faucet models of these types: `single handle`, `double handle`.
Repeat the parameter for several.

parameters.name: supplier_id
parameters.description: Only faucet models bought from this supplier (a supplier id).

parameters.name: include_sold_out
parameters.description:
`true` also returns sold out models: no free unit and not regular
stock. Default `false`.

parameters.name: available_only
parameters.description:
`true` returns only models with at least one free unit, even regular
stock ones without units (what can be installed on a sale right now).
Overrides `include_sold_out`. Default `false`.

400.description: A filter has the wrong type, e.g. `supplier_id=abc`

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

get.description:
Returns the slabs of the caller's company among the given ids (others are
left out), each with its bundle label and its stone (id, name, type).
Use it to label slabs already chosen on a sale.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
Slab ids to return; repeat the parameter (`?id=1&id=2`). Required:
without ids the list is empty.

400.description: An id is not a number

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

patch.description:
Sets the length and width (inches) of one slab or remnant of the
caller's company. Both must be positive numbers. Returns no body; reload
the stone's slabs (`GET /v1/stones/{id}/slabs`) to see the change.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Slab id

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

404.description: No such slab in the caller's company

get.description:
Returns the sale's customer, seller, notes, price and its rooms, each with
the slabs used (`is_full` false when only part of a slab was sold), the
sinks and faucets installed, and the room options. 404 when the sale is
not the company's or no slab is left on it. Save changes with
`PUT /v1/sales/{id}`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Sale id

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

404.description: No such sale with slabs in the caller's company

put.description:
Replaces the sale's customer, notes, price, rooms, slabs, sinks and
faucets with the body (the seller only when `seller_id` is given). Slabs
may be ones the sale already has or available ones; slabs left out are
freed, with their sinks and faucets. All or nothing.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Sale id

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

404.description: No such sale in the caller's company

post.description:
Creates a pending sale dated now. Each room needs square feet and at least
one available slab of the company; a slab sold partially
(`is_full: false`) leaves a remnant in the yard, and a slab used in
several rooms gets a piece cut from it for each later room. Sinks and
faucets take one free unit of each model, installed on the room's first
slab. A customer without a sales rep gets the seller. All or nothing: any
error leaves the data unchanged.

400.description: Invalid body: no rooms, a room without slabs or square feet, unknown customer/slab/model, a slab already sold, or no free unit of a sink/faucet model

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

post.description:
Marks the sale cancelled, frees its slabs and the sinks and faucets on
them, and removes the free remnants its partial slabs left. Remnants that
another sale bought are kept. Returns no body.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Sale id

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

404.description: No such sale in the caller's company

revenue_generated.description:
Sum of sale prices as a decimal string (e.g. `"1500.00"`), the way
mysql2 returns DECIMAL; null when there are no sales.

CompanyRow.description:
A customer row of the `companies` view, with totals over its own sales
and those of its child customers.

CustomerDetail.description: One customer with contact details, as the customer picker shows it.

email.description: Primary email address; null when the customer has none.

company_name.description: Company name for business customers; null or empty for private ones.

source.description: Where the lead came from, e.g. `leads`, `check-in`, `other`.

your_message.description: Message the customer left when signing up.

sales_rep.description: Assigned sales rep (user id); null when unassigned.

sales_rep_name.description: Name of the assigned sales rep; null when unassigned or deleted.

CustomerRow.description:
One row of the customers table. Field names match the Remix
`CustomersListCustomer` type exactly, including `customerTemperature`.

email.description:
Primary email address; all addresses come from
`POST /v1/customers/emails/batch`.

sales_rep.description: User id of the assigned sales rep.

assigned_date.description: When the current sales rep was assigned.

sales_rep_name.description: Name of the assigned sales rep; null if unassigned or the rep was deleted.

source.description: Lead source, e.g. a website form or referral.

invalid_lead.description: Reason the lead was marked invalid. Null or empty means valid.

company_name.description: Business name when the customer is a company (contractor, designer...).

customerTemperature.description: Lead temperature: `hot`, `medium` or `cold`; null if not set.

CustomerSearchRow.description: A customer matching a search, with their latest deal.

deal_id.description: The customer's most recent live deal; null when none.

deal_is_won.description: That deal's outcome: 1 won, 0 lost, null open or no deal.

deal_group_id.description: Board group of that deal's list; null when there is no deal.

customer_ids.description: Customer ids to look up, at most 20000. Ids of other companies are ignored.

error.description:
Short reason: `unauthorized`, `forbidden`, `not found`, `database error`, or the
bad-request message (e.g. `invalid sales_rep: abc`).

Faucet.description: A faucet model the company sells, with how many units are free to sell.

type.description: Faucet type, e.g. `single handle` or `double handle`.

is_display.description: Shown to customers in the showroom catalog.

regular_stock.description: Always orderable from the supplier, so never sold out even with no units.

retail_price.description: Retail price as a decimal string, e.g. `"129.99"`; null if not set.

cost.description: Purchase cost as a decimal string; null if not set.

available.description: Units in stock that are not installed on a sold slab.

FixtureInput.description: A sink or faucet model to install, with the price charged.

PositionRow.description: A position the user holds in the current company.

slab_ids.description: Ids of the slabs added, in order.

type.description: Material type; must be one of the company's stone types.

retail_price.description: Retail price per square foot in dollars; must be positive.

length.description: Slab length in inches; 0 when unknown.

width.description: Slab width in inches; 0 when unknown.

leftover.description:
`true` adds one leftover slab with a generated bundle (`LO-YYYYMMDD-XXXX`);
`false` adds one slab per entry of `bundles`.

bundles.description: Bundle labels of the slabs to add when `leftover` is false.

RoomInput.description: One room of a sale being saved.

room_id.description: Room UUID (any version), shared by its slabs.

square_feet.description: Square feet of the room; must be positive.

retail_price.description: Price per square foot in dollars.

slabs.description:
Slabs used in the room. The same slab may appear in several rooms:
each later room gets its own piece cut from it.

sinks.description: Sinks to install: one free unit of each model is taken.

faucets.description: Faucets to install: one free unit of each model is taken.

SaleContract.description:
A sale as the sell / edit form shows it: who bought, who sold, and the
rooms with their slabs, sinks and faucets.

seller_id.description: User credited with the sale; null if unknown.

project_address.description: Address of the job; null or empty means the customer's address.

price.description: Total price, decimal string (e.g. "4200.00"); null if not set.

company_name.description: The customer's company name; null for private customers.

extras.description:
Extra line items of the whole sale (`[{"adjustment": "...", "price": 0}]`),
as saved; null when none were saved.

rooms.description: Rooms in the order their first slab was added.

SaleFixture.description: A sink or faucet unit on a sale.

price.description: Price charged for the unit, decimal string; null if not set.

customer_id.description: Customer who buys; must be a live customer of the company.

seller_id.description:
User credited with the sale. Defaults to the caller when selling;
left unchanged when editing.

project_address.description: Address of the job. Empty or missing uses the customer's address.

notes.description: Notes on the whole sale; empty clears them.

extras.description: Extra line items of the whole sale, stored as given.

rooms.description: At least one room, each with at least one slab.

SaleRoom.description:
One room of a sale. Room fields are stored on each of its slabs; these
come from the room's first slab. Nulls mean "not set" (the form uses its
defaults).

room_id.description: Room UUID shared by its slabs; null for old sales saved without one.

room.description: Room name, e.g. `kitchen`, `bathroom`, or free text.

backsplash.description: Backsplash: `no`, `4 inch`, `full height`, or free text.

square_feet.description: Square feet of the room, decimal string.

retail_price.description: Price per square foot, decimal string.

extras.description: Room extras (edge, tear-out, stove... prices) as saved.

sinks.description: Sinks installed on the room's first slab.

faucets.description: Faucets installed on the room's first slab.

SaleSlab.description: A slab used in a room.

is_full.description:
`true` when the whole slab is sold. `false` when only part of it is:
selling then leaves a remnant (a child slab) in the yard.

SessionUser.description: The signed-in user, after the super-admin rule is applied.

is_employee.description: Staff member of the company (sees customers, deals, inventory).

is_admin.description: Company admin. Always true for super admins.

company_id.description:
Company every request acts in. For a super admin this is the company
selected in the session, otherwise the user's own company.

pined_bar.description: UI preference: the sidebar is pinned open.

cloudtalk_agent_id.description: CloudTalk telephony agent id, when the user has a CloudTalk seat.

ringcentral_extension_id.description: RingCentral extension id, when the user has a RingCentral seat.

is_signature_available.description: Feature flag: the user may use e-signatures.

Sink.description: A sink model the company sells, with how many units are free to sell.

type.description: Sink type, e.g. `stainless 18 gauge` or `farm house`.

is_display.description: Shown to customers in the showroom catalog.

regular_stock.description: Always orderable from the supplier, so never sold out even with no units.

length.description: Length in inches; 0 if not set.

width.description: Width in inches; 0 if not set.

retail_price.description: Retail price as a decimal string, e.g. `"199.00"`; null if not set.

cost.description: Purchase cost as a decimal string; null if not set.

available.description: Units in stock that are not installed on a sold slab.

SlabCounts.description:
Slab counts of a stone. Counts the stone's own slabs plus those of the
stones it draws from (linked stones). Cut and deleted slabs are never
counted.

total.description: Slabs and remnants in the yard, sold or not.

available.description: Slabs and remnants not tied to a sale.

whole_total.description: Whole slabs (not remnants) in the yard, sold or not.

whole_available.description: Whole slabs (not remnants) not tied to a sale.

SlabParentSale.description: Who bought and sold the slab a remnant was cut from.

id.description: Sale id of the parent slab.

customer_name.description: Customer name; null when the sale has no customer.

SlabSale.description: The sale a slab belongs to, as shown when hovering a sold slab.

id.description: Sale id; open it with the sale routes.

sale_date.description: When the sale was made; null for old sales without a date.

customer_name.description: Customer name; null when the sale has no customer.

seller_name.description: Name of the user who sold it; null when unknown.

square_feet.description: Total square feet of the sale, decimal string (e.g. "55.50").

room.description: Room this slab is used in, e.g. "Kitchen".

slab_square_feet.description: Square feet of this slab used in the room, decimal string.

sink_names.description:
Names of the sinks installed on any slab of this sale, one entry per
sink (repeated names mean several units), in installation order.

SlabStone.description: The stone a slab belongs to.

SlabSummary.description: A slab by id, with the stone it belongs to.

Stone.description: A stone (a color/material the company sells) with its slab inventory.

url.description: Image URL; null when the stone has no picture.

is_display.description: Shown in catalogs. This route only returns displayed stones, so always true.

regular_stock.description: Always orderable from the supplier, so never sold out even without slabs.

length.description: Typical slab length in inches; null if not set.

width.description: Typical slab width in inches; null if not set.

retail_price.description:
Retail price in whole dollars. 0 means the stone is sold by the slab
at `cost_per_sqft`.

cost_per_sqft.description: Cost per square foot in whole dollars.

level.description: Price level, 1 (cheapest) to 7; null if not set.

finishing.description: Surface finish: `polished`, `leathered` or `honed`; null if not set.

samples_importance.description: How important it is to keep samples in stock; null if not set.

bundle_location.description: Where the bundle is stored in the yard, free text.

delivery_date.description: Expected delivery date, `YYYY-MM-DD`; null if not set.

StoneDetail.description: One stone with everything an edit form shows.

url.description: Image URL; null when the stone has no picture.

is_display.description: Shown in the employee and customer catalogs.

regular_stock.description: Always orderable from the supplier, so never sold out even without slabs.

length.description: Typical slab length in inches; null if not set.

width.description: Typical slab width in inches; null if not set.

retail_price.description: Retail price in whole dollars. 0 means the stone is sold by the slab.

cost_per_sqft.description: Cost per square foot in whole dollars.

level.description: Price level, 1 (cheapest) to 7; null if not set.

finishing.description: Surface finish: `polished`, `leathered` or `honed`; null if not set.

samples_importance.description: How important it is to keep samples in stock; null if not set.

bundle_location.description: Where the bundle is stored in the yard, free text.

delivery_date.description: Expected delivery date, `YYYY-MM-DD`; null if not set.

color_ids.description: Ids of the colors the stone is tagged with, ascending.

StoneRef.description: A stone, by id and name.

StoneSlab.description: A slab or remnant of a stone, as the slabs dialog lists it.

bundle.description:
Bundle label written on the slab, e.g. "B-12-1" or "Slab 2". Remnants
keep the label of the slab they were cut from.

url.description: Photo of this slab; null when it has none (show the stone image).

length.description: Length in inches as entered, e.g. "126.5".

width.description: Width in inches as entered, e.g. "63".

parent_id.description: The slab this remnant was cut from; null for a whole slab.

child_count.description:
Remnants cut from this slab that are not deleted (sold, free or cut).
A slab with remnants can only be sold partially.

oneOf.description:
Set when the slab belongs to a stone this stone draws from (linked

sale_id.description:
Id of the sale the slab is part of; null while it is available. Set
even when the sale row itself is missing (then `sale` is null).

oneOf.description: The sale the slab is part of; null while it is available.

The sale of the slab this remnant was cut from; null for whole slabs
and for remnants of unsold slabs.

length.description: New length in inches; a positive number, decimals allowed.

width.description: New width in inches; a positive number, decimals allowed.

UserNameRow.description: A user's id and display name.
